title: Macro placement
label: A pick-and-place gantry over a chip die. Eight hard macros start in two stacks on a staging plate, overlapping each other. The gantry lifts each one and sets it on the die where it overlaps nothing; a dial gauge settles at the verified average proxy cost of 0.9507 when the last macro lands.

keys.label: Hard macros: start stacked, end legal

title: The iteration loop
label: An indexing turntable carries a die through five stations: Floorplan, Place, CTS, Route and Timing check. When the timing check fails its lamp lights and the die is carried all the way round to Floorplan again, while a tally counter on the front counts each loop.

keys.label: Five stations of the physical design flow

title: PD orchestrator
label: An orchestrator column with one swinging arm visits three sub-agents in turn: a planning desk, a runtime press that runs the flow on a die, and an analyzer gauge that reads the worst timing slack. After each run it files a card in a memory cabinet. The slack improves run by run until timing is met.

keys.label: Sub-agents: plan, run, analyze, and the memory cabinet

title: ChipOS line
label: ChipOS as a production line: a conveyor carries a die blank under five agent stations, Spec, RTL, Synthesis, Layout and GDSII. Each station dips its tool and leaves its work on the die, and the finished die drops into the out tray at the end.
